purpose: What each source's own terms say about quoting it, read once and written down so that neither a permission nor a refusal has to be worked out twice. The site promises in six languages that an organisation may ask not to appear; this is where that promise is kept, and where a reading of a published notice is recorded with the sentence it rests on.

sources.quote: no se permite la reproducción y/o publicación, total o parcial, del sitio web, ni su tratamiento informático, su distribución, su difusión, ni su modificación, transformación o descompilación, ni demás derechos reconocidos legalmente a su titular, sin el permiso previo y por escrito del mismo
sources.finding: The notice reserves reproduction and publication of the site, in whole or in part, to prior written permission, and limits the material to personal and private use, so this project cannot quote it — and every record here rests on quoted words. Linking is a separate question and the same notice answers it the other way: it contemplates third-party hyperlinks that open the full page and say nothing misleading.
sources.route: Permission is reserved rather than refused. Asking in writing would settle it, and the operator publishes its address in the same notice.

sources.quote: Tous les liens vers la page d’accueil ou l’une des pages internet du site, ainsi que tous les liens directs ou profonds vers un contenu, nonobstant leur forme, sont interdits, sauf autorisation expresse de l’éditeur du site.
sources.finding: The notice forbids every link to the site, home page or deep, without express authorisation, and that alone means no record may cite it. It also authorises reproduction of content on three conditions this project meets — unaltered, source cited, distribution free — but only for educational use, and whether a public directory is an educational use is this project's reading of its own purpose rather than something the notice settles. So the quoting use is recorded as unread. A first reading saw the permission, stopped there, and recorded the host as permitted outright.
sources.route: The link ban is what stands in the way, and the notice reserves authorisation rather than refusing it. Asking the publisher would settle it.

sources.quote: la Junta permite la reproducción, distribución y/o comunicación pública de la información contenida en la sede electrónica, siempre que se cumplan los siguientes criterios
sources.finding: The regional government permits reproducing and communicating the information of its electronic office under Law 37/2007, on three conditions: always cite the source, do not distort the meaning, and give the date of the last publication. Records quoting it carry the source; the date of last publication must be stated where the page shows one. Reuse may still be limited by personal data or third-party rights.

sources.quote: No son objeto de propiedad intelectual las disposiciones legales o reglamentarias y sus correspondientes proyectos, las resoluciones de los órganos jurisdiccionales y los actos, acuerdos, deliberaciones y dictámenes de los organismos públicos, así como las traducciones oficiales de todos los textos anteriores.
sources.finding: The Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha publishes legal provisions and acts of public bodies, which Spanish copyright law (article 13 of the Ley de Propiedad Intelectual) excludes from intellectual property; this project reads quoting and linking them as permitted. It is a reading of the law, not a permission from the portal, whose general notice is read separately.
